title: tx_queue_platform_now_ms returns wrong value on success
description: Line 62 returns '(uint32_t)(ts.tv_sec * 1000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000)' directly as the function return value instead of storing it in '*now_ms' and returning 0. The function signature is 'int tx_queue_platform_now_ms(uint32_t *now_ms)' which expects return 0 on success with the time stored in the output parameter. This leaves *now_ms uninitialized and interprets the time value as an error code.
close_reason: Already fixed in current code. Lines 52-61 now correctly store time in *now_ms and return 0.
